name: Puntuación de Lectura Labial
description: Correlaciona movimiento labial con audio para detectar manipulación
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Lip Reading Accuracy Score
mechanism:
This method performs lip reading analysis for audio-visual deepfake detection:

1. **Visual Habla Feature Extracción**: Lip region is cropped and normalized per frame, extracting visual speech features — lip shape (inner/outer contour), lip area, mouth opening, tongue visibility, and teeth exposure. These features encode the visual aspect of speech articulation (visemes).

2. **Viseme Sequence Decoding**: The visual speech features are analyzed to determine which phonological units (visemes) are being articulated. Visemes are decoded from the lip motion sequence using temporal pattern recognition.

3. **Audio - Visual Concordance**: Decoded visual phonemes are compared with phonemes derived from the audio speech signal. In authentic video, visual and audio phonemes should match — the lips should form shapes corresponding to the spoken sounds. Deepfakes with mismatched audio may show visual-audio phoneme disagreements per Chung & Zisserman (2017).

4. **Articulation Quality Evaluación**: Natural speech articulation involves precisely coordinated lip, tongue, jaw, and cheek movements. The method evaluates articulation quality — whether lip shapes fully achieve the target viseme positions. Deepfake lip generation may produce under-articulated or over-simplified lip movements that approximate but don't fully achieve correct viseme shapes.

5. **Coarticulation Análisis**: In natural speech, phoneme production is influenced by surrounding phonemes (coarticulation) — the lips begin transitioning to the next sound before completing the current one. The method checks for natural coarticulation effects. AI lip generation may produce discrete viseme transitions without the smooth blending of coarticulation.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
